mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,000,000 units (1000.0 thousand) signal reduced consumer confidence in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: An inflation rate above 230 (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% month-over-month) boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 103 (relative to 2017=100) indicates expanding supply capacity, supporting corporate profits and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 103.
